column1: Increases damage and critical damage dealt for ally units that primarily deal Electric or melee damage. column1: Nikketa's Ultimate skill is her primary source of damage. Increasing its damage output will boost Nikketa's DPS in general. Additionally, the Hydro debuff she applies increases damage dealt for both herself and her summon.

column1: In addition to Nikketa herself being able to use her Ultimate skill, Kulich's counterattacks will also trigger it. Thus, increasing her Ultimate skill's damage will effectively increase Nikketa's overall DPS.

column1: Fixed Keys: Her Fixed Key - Righteous Doll increases Nikketa's Confectance Index gain. With sufficient Confectance Index, it also boosts the damage of her Ultimate skill. The Fixed Key - Just Desserts enables her to apply Hydro weakness to the enemy, while her Fixed Key - Oppressive Air grants Nikketa a constant attack boost throughout the battle, enhancing her sustained damage output.\nShared Key: Nikketa's Shared Key enhances her DPS by increasing out-of-turn damage dealt by her Ultimate skill when triggered via counterattacks. column2: Fixed Key: Fixed Key - Righteous Doll miliknya menaikkan perolehan Confectance Index Nikketa. Dengan Confectance Index yang cukup, ini juga mendongkrak damage skill Ultimate-nya. Selain itu, dengan Kulich ada di medan, efek Insight tetap aktif sepanjang pertempuran, sehingga jangkauan dan efektivitasnya makin luas.

column1: Fixed Keys: The Fixed Key - Hidden Passion can accelerate the triggering of the Thermal Conduction mechanic and allows Loreley to immediately use her Ultimate skill, the Fixed Key - Pain Threshold allows her to apply Overburn in a wide area, inflicting Burn-type debuffs and triggering her allies' Emergency Supports, while the Fixed Key: Enchanting Dream can increase the damage output of all Burn-type units.\nCommon Keys: The Common Key - Afterglow and the Common Key - Death Knell provide an effective increase to Loreley's damage output. Loreley can continuously provide Burn-type buffs for herself, which meshes perfectly with the critical rate increase from the Common Key - Satisfied Sigh.
column2: Fixed Key: Fixed Key - Hidden Passion bisa mempercepat terpicunya mekanik Thermal Conduction dan membuat Loreley bisa langsung memakai skill Ultimate-nya, Fixed Key - Pain Threshold membuatnya bisa menempelkan Overburn di area luas, menimbulkan debuff tipe Burn dan memicu Emergency Support sekutunya, sementara Fixed Key: Enchanting Dream bisa menaikkan output damage semua unit tipe Burn.\nCommon Key: Common Key - Afterglow dan Common Key - Death Knell memberi kenaikan output damage Loreley yang efektif. Loreley bisa terus-menerus memberi buff tipe Burn untuk dirinya sendiri, dan itu klop dengan kenaikan critical rate dari Common Key - Satisfied Sigh.

column1: Enhancing the first 2 attacks made each turn allows Cheyanne to deliver greater burst damage when facing a single enemy.
column2: Memperkuat 2 serangan pertama tiap giliran membuat Cheyanne bisa melepas burst damage lebih besar saat menghadapi satu musuh.

column1: Cheyanne's map-wide attack range allows her to attack enemies in distant positions and makes it easier to trigger the damage-increasing effect.
column2: Jangkauan serangan Cheyanne yang mencakup seluruh peta membuatnya bisa menyerang musuh di posisi jauh sekaligus mempermudah terpicunya efek penambah damage.

column1: Fixed Keys: In normal battles, the Fixed Key - Brave Little Step allows Cheyanne to ignore terrain more effectively. The Fixed Key - Social Maladjustment improves Cheyanne's ability to engage multiple targets in succession. The Fixed Key - Psychological Resilience provides a consistent boost to her damage output. \nCommon Keys: Cheyanne can easily meet the trigger conditions for Common Key - Love Is Reunion and Common Key - Center's Might, maintaining a full uptime on them. With support from her teammates, she can trigger Common Key - Complete Liberation more reliably.
column2: Fixed Key: di pertempuran biasa, Fixed Key - Brave Little Step membuat Cheyanne bisa mengabaikan medan dengan lebih efektif. Fixed Key - Social Maladjustment memperbaiki kemampuan Cheyanne menghadapi banyak target secara beruntun. Fixed Key - Psychological Resilience memberi dongkrakan output damage yang konsisten. \nCommon Key: Cheyanne gampang memenuhi syarat pemicu Common Key - Love Is Reunion dan Common Key - Center's Might, sehingga keduanya aktif sepanjang waktu. Dengan dukungan rekan setimnya, dia bisa memicu Common Key - Complete Liberation lebih konsisten.
